name: WhatsApp Web
description: Let people start and continue Paperclip work with an agent from WhatsApp by pairing a phone through WhatsApp Web.

methods.label: Chat with an agent
methods.whenToUse: Let people in WhatsApp start and continue work with one Paperclip agent after pairing a phone with WhatsApp Web.
methods.guidanceMd: Pair one WhatsApp account by scanning a QR code in Paperclip. This uses the unofficial WhatsApp Web client (whatsapp-web.js) with a local Chromium session. No public webhook URL is required. Self-host with Chromium available; multi-replica cloud session sharing is not supported in V1. WhatsApp may restrict unofficial clients.
